description:
Import orders that never reached ApparelHub and refresh order status from fulfillment providers. For each connected Shopify shop it imports recent orders a webhook should have delivered, scoped to orders placed after the shop was connected and excluding cancelled or already-fulfilled ones (an imported paid order is sent to the fulfillment provider like a live one). Pass store_uuid to sync one store; omit it for all stores. Read `shopify[]`: `processed` imported now, `not_eligible_reasons` why others were left alone, `truncated` means run again, `outcome: "auth_revoked"` carries a reconnect_url the merchant must open. Report `errors[]`.

[#e208cf]

store_uuid.description: Scope the sync to one store (omit for all stores).

workspace.description: Workspace uuid to scope to (agency accounts). Omit for the Default workspace.

name: sync_orders
